root_idea.summary: The root centers on directing sight toward something and attending to it, whether by visual observation or by mental consideration.
root_idea.development: From direct looking and visual encounter, the lexical range extends to examination and understanding, waiting for what is expected, comparison or correspondence, and constructions involving delay or beneficent regard.

qac_form_accounting.reason: This is the masculine plural active-participle form of نَاظِر and is presented under the normalized singular citation form.

senses.definition: To look at, look toward, or see something.
senses.usage_conditions: The basic visual use includes directing the sight toward an object whether or not it is actually seen.

senses.definition: To consider, examine, or investigate something in order to understand it.
senses.usage_conditions: With an object of thought, an affair, writing, or a field of knowledge, the verb denotes mental examination and reflection rather than mere visual sight.

senses.definition: To wait for or await someone or something.
senses.usage_conditions: This use is distinct from visual looking and may describe expectation of an event or outcome.

senses.definition: To face or be oriented toward someone or something.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction may describe apparent orientation toward an object even when the subject does not actually see it.

senses.definition: To look on in bewilderment or helpless uncertainty.
senses.usage_conditions: In certain Quranic contexts, looking expresses perplexity and lack of effective agency; this is a contextual use of looking, not a general replacement for the basic visual sense.

senses.definition: To regard with favor, mercy, or beneficent attention.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially when attributed to God, the expression can denote merciful regard, favor, aid, or the bestowal of benefits rather than visual sight.

senses.definition: To heed or listen to someone.
senses.usage_conditions: This specialized imperative construction is attested in the Quranic expression addressed to someone being asked to attend to the speaker.

senses.definition: To grant someone a delay or respite; to defer something.
senses.usage_conditions: The active use means granting time, while the passive Quranic use means being granted or given that respite.

senses.definition: To wait for, await, or expect someone or something.
senses.usage_conditions: Without an object, the verb can emphasize remaining patiently or deliberately in expectation.

senses.definition: One granted a delay or respite; reprieved.
senses.usage_conditions: This passive participle describes persons whose punishment, end, or appointed action has been deferred.

senses.definition: One who waits, awaits, or expects.
senses.usage_conditions: The form denotes people remaining in expectation of an event or outcome.

senses.definition: Looking at, observing, or directing one's gaze toward something.
senses.usage_conditions: This active participle describes one engaged in visual observation; it should not automatically be interpreted as waiting.
In constructions concerning an anticipated result or event, the active participle can mean awaiting rather than looking.

senses.definition: A look or act of looking.
senses.usage_conditions: This verbal noun denotes the occurrence or exercise of looking.
In the Quranic legal-economic construction, it is an extension of time granted until the debtor reaches ease.

senses.definition: A look, brief look, or glance.
senses.usage_conditions: The form denotes a single or quick act of looking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the earth or land: to show its plants or herbage to the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of appearing visibly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of fortune or time: to oppose or destroy people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression; the source records some uncertainty about this interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To judge between people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative judicial use of considering the matter between them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To practise divination or examine by insight and skill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use referring to divinatory examination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or look out for someone on another's behalf.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction means to search for or find a specified person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look to someone for expected bounty or favor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object marked by إلى is the hoped-for source of a benefit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To accomplish a person's want or provide what is needed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A beneficent transitive construction distinct from ordinary visual looking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sell something with payment postponed; to sell on credit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This commercial use concerns deferring the buyer's payment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To discuss, examine, or investigate a matter with someone; to hold a debate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction can involve exchanging arguments and opinions in order to establish the truth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To face, correspond to, resemble, or be nearly equal to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This branch covers reciprocal orientation and comparison of persons, things, or forces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To compare one thing with another or make one thing like another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may involve likening or applying one thing as a comparison for another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be made like or comparable to another thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive Form IV construction of being rendered similar.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sell something with payment postponed; to sell on credit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the commercial extension of granting the buyer additional time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To face one another or stand opposite one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of people, houses, or other things positioned toward each other.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask someone for or seek a postponement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form X construction expresses requesting additional time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A request for time to complete a purchase or payment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional exchange in which one party asks for a delay before buying or paying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The distance or interval encompassed by a look.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of nearness measured by the extent of what can be seen at a glance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A group whose members are mutually visible or live close enough to see one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of neighboring or adjacent people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To require consideration because of obscurity, weakness, or lack of clarity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A polite expression of doubt or reservation about a statement or matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The better of two available choices or options.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression for having the option to retain or return something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An affliction attributed to an evil eye, a jinn, slight insanity, or a swoon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized meaning refers to the harmful effect rather than to an ordinary glance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An alteration of the body or complexion caused by emaciation, hunger, travel, or similar hardship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical change or deterioration in appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Foulness, ugliness, bad appearance, defect, or imperfection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive use for an undesirable appearance or flaw.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Reverence, veneration, awe, or fear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative emotional extension recorded in the lexical sources.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Compassion, pity, or mercy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative affective use distinct from the physical act of looking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A credit term or sale with payment postponed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The commercial use describes buying or selling on deferred payment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Speculative knowledge or science acquired through study and reasoning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is opposed to immediate or necessary knowledge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wait!
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed imperative expression synonymous with “wait” or “await.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whom a community looks to, imitates, or follows as a model.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may apply to a male or female chief or exemplary person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who does not neglect to watch or consider what causes concern.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning emphasizes attentiveness to a troubling matter or person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A counterpart, opposite, like, similar, or equal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term applies broadly to persons and things that correspond or match one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A scout or lookout; one who observes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural may denote scouts collectively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The more excellent or distinguished people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural figurative use based on their resemblance in character, action, or speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sharp-spirited horse that raises its eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive equine term for alert, spirited bearing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A group of people looking at something; spectators or observers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective noun for people engaged in observation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pupil or visible black of the eye; by extension, the eye or sight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is also used for the eye's seeing organ or sight itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who looks with a full, clear gaze and is free of suspicion or reproach.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression describing a person's outward or moral clearness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two veins at the edges of the nose extending from the inner corners of the eyes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A guardian, keeper, or watcher.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized active participle denoting someone entrusted with watching over something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who looks to someone for hoped-for bounty or favor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction in which the person looked toward is the expected source of benefit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or state in which a person or thing is pleasing to look at.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can describe a favorable setting or condition from which something is viewed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The outward aspect or appearance of a person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may be contrasted with the inner condition or reality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An elevated lookout, watch-post, or place from which one observes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term includes a high place on a mountain and, in later or vulgar usage, a building or room commanding a view.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a pleasing or goodly appearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive adjective concerning outward aspect, sometimes paired with good inner qualities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mirror in which the face is seen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An instrument used for viewing one's reflected appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A telescope or device through which distant things appear near.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized optical-instrument meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person affected by an evil eye or related jinn affliction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participle describes someone suffering the effect called a نَظْرَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose bounty is hoped for and toward whom people look.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of a benefactor or person of authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman affected by a fault, defect, or imperfection attributed to a نَظْرَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized feminine passive-participle use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be affected by an evil eye or related jinn affliction, or by a swoon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive Form I verb describes becoming subject to the condition called a نَظْرَة.

cautions: The Form I verb and the active participle نَاظِرٌ can denote either looking or waiting depending on construction and context; the Quranic evidence supports both branches.
The interpretation of إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ in 75:23 is explicitly contested in the lexical evidence; it is represented here as looking, while other Quranic contexts support the waiting sense.
